body:
John McCarthy wrote:
> 
> johnnine7 includes the quotation from TK
> 
> 9. The two psychological tendencies that underlie modern leftism we call
> "feelings of inferiority" and "oversocialization."
>   Feelings of inferiority are characteristic of modern leftism as a whole,
>   while oversocialization is characteristic only of a certain segment of modern
>   leftism; but this segment is highly influential.
> 
> I can't see either of them as being characteristic of leftists.
> Leftism is better characterized by certain fixed ideas that
> capitalists are to blame for all society's troubles.  David Horowitz
> has a review in the current Salon (www.salon999.com) of the new book
> by Richard Rorty.  Rorty, who started as a Trotskyite, recognizes the
> intellectual collapse of leftism as providing a goal for society.
> Nevertheless, he preserves all his old notions of who are the bad
> guys.
> 
> However, having psychologized the leftists, TK should expect to be
> psychologized himself.

	It becomes clear in the course of the text that FC is trying to talk
about a psychological type that overlaps, but is not identical with,
adherence to leftist ideals.  I can say more, but I just posted a longer
opinion on this a little while back.

Scott
